results.title: Kate Beckinsale Wipes Instagram After Brutal Weight-Shaming
results.description: Daniele Venturelli / Getty Images for The Summer Gala by Gala One Actress Kate Beckinsale wiped her Instagram clean after reaching her breaking point with comments about her weight. The 53-year-old Serendipity star deleted every post from her account, which has amassed over 5 million followers, after sharing dozens of screenshots on Saturday of cruel remarks about her appearance. “Loosen up the [Ozempic]!! You were divine and now you look anorexic!” read one comment she screenshotted and shared. Read more at The Daily Beast.
